Resolves #19105

`CONTRIBUTING.md` §3 now says where the project is and what comes after a first PR:
- 13.2 is the first engine release since the split;
- `ROADMAP.md` says what ships and why;
- the v13.2 milestone holds the open work;
- the README's repository map names the repositories, and how each one releases is stated in one line;
- item 1 separates the entry label from the next step. A good first issue is for a first PR; after the first merged PR, `help wanted` or an unassigned v13.2 issue. Good first issues stay reserved for first-time contributors.

Everything is linked, not restated: +11/−2.

Evidence: docs-only, no runtime AC. `buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` reads the **git index**, so it was run with the change staged at `d63c28c9f8`: exit 0, 247 links resolved. Control: the same guard on `f3ea2f21ae`'s index exits 1. agent-preflight: not hosted here (Brain-hosted); class declared `docs` (zero-delta).

Micro-review eligible: docs — two paragraphs in one entry document, no behaviour.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | §3's opening block links `ROADMAP.md`, the v13.2 milestone (`https://github.com/neomjs/neo/milestone/9`) and `README.md#the-repository-map`, and names the `neo.mjs` npm package, the Brain's container images and `neo-agent-skills` on npm. |
| AC-2 | §3 item 1: a good first issue for a first PR; after the first merged PR, `help wanted` or an unassigned v13.2 issue. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The Institution is left out of the release line because it has not released yet (`ROADMAP.md`'s line table), so the text says the repositories "release independently" rather than "each on its own cadence".

## Test Evidence
Outside CI: the relative-link guard, run on the staged head with a failing control (receipt above). Everything else runs in CI.

## Evolution
The first head's body claimed a local link-guard pass that tested nothing. I ran the guard before `git add`, and since it reads the index, it audited the old `CONTRIBUTING.md` (245 links; the new file has 247). CI's Doc Link Guard caught the real failure: `../../milestone/9` is not a repository tab the guard knows (its list has the plural `milestones`). `d63c28c9f8` links the milestone by its canonical URL, which is also right for a fork, because the milestone lives upstream.
